agents.name: Research contradiction review assistant
agents.trigger: A supplied paper is added or corrected, or the user requests a comparison review.

agents.name: Bibliography revision review assistant
agents.trigger: The manuscript citation set, style requirement or reference metadata changes.

agents.name: Reviewer response progress assistant
agents.trigger: An author supplies revised manuscript evidence, a reviewer comment or a response deadline.

agents.name: Case competition evidence review assistant
agents.trigger: The team changes its recommendation, financial exhibit or judging rubric.

agents.name: Equity assumption review assistant
agents.trigger: A new filing, dated market exhibit or valuation assumption is supplied for the same company.

agents.name: Capstone commitment review assistant
agents.trigger: A team milestone is due or an accepted commitment or assignment requirement changes.

agents.name: Restaurant shift exception review assistant
agents.trigger: A new shift handover is supplied with unresolved orders, equipment or safety escalations.

agents.name: Catering order change review assistant
agents.trigger: The customer-approved headcount, dietary requirements, timing or quoted charges change.

agents.name: Property maintenance evidence review assistant
agents.trigger: A maintenance status, accepted appointment or access approval changes.

agents.name: Construction variation review assistant
agents.trigger: A priced variation or contract approval record changes.

agents.name: Grant spending evidence review assistant
agents.trigger: A grant reporting checkpoint is due or new eligible transaction evidence is supplied.

agents.name: Volunteer induction evidence review assistant
agents.trigger: An approved volunteer role or required induction evidence changes.

agents.name: Supplier correction evidence review assistant
agents.trigger: A supplier sends corrective action evidence or an effectiveness review becomes due.

agents.name: Warehouse count discrepancy review assistant
agents.trigger: A revised count or intervening movement record is supplied for the same snapshot.

agents.name: Referral administration evidence review assistant
agents.trigger: A new referral receipt, booking or administrative follow-up confirmation is supplied.

agents.name: Client scope decision review assistant
agents.trigger: A client changes scope or supplies an acceptance or rejection decision.

agents.name: Report definition drift review assistant
agents.trigger: A recurring report changes its formula, source grain, time window or exclusions.

agents.name: Procurement evidence gap review assistant
agents.trigger: A vendor supplies new evidence or a mandatory procurement check becomes due.

agents.name: AI pilot evaluation review assistant
agents.trigger: A bounded pilot receives new representative test results or an approved gate becomes due.

agents.name: Pilot customer promise review assistant
agents.trigger: An accepted pilot commitment changes or actual delivery evidence arrives.

verificationScope: 50 original and new utility unit cases, TypeScript compile, source method review and 4 native adapter fixtures passed. Final frozen-build browser, exact download and production checks are recorded separately. Method and pack verification do not claim execution of all business workflows; agent installation does not start a schedule.
